title: Verify typed recipe picker and explicit start
platforms: Windows GNU under Wine/Xvfb, isolated EUR session
changes: Verify interactive selection of a saved recipe and its original isolated session and require Details before Start.
validation: A simulated keyboard and mouse selected both entries; Start before Details was refused without a run, then Details and Start completed exactly one frame and a completed checkpoint step. The GUI closed normally and protected inputs remained unchanged.
The earlier retained driver attempts failed before this path completed; a focused Sol xhigh read-only consultation identified physical Enter and virtual Clear routing.
limitations: One EUR Wine/Xvfb path only; native Windows, physical input, wider picker scenarios and cross-restart recovery remain unverified.
